page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9a.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T25 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a resource-dense configuration for workloads that require dedicated CPU cycles without the overhead of excess memory or local storage.

The hardware profile is designed for compute-intensive workloads that do not require GPU acceleration or high local storage IOPS. Suitable applications include web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and CI/CD pipelines where CPU execution speed and dedicated core allocation are critical.
